βάλοιμι: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. opt. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I would strike’
δοίης: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you might give’
εἴλυτο: εἰλύω — wrap, envelop; plpf. pass. 3 sg. with stative force: ’lay wrapped’
εὐρυοδείης: εὐρυόδεια — wide-wayed (fem. adj., of the earth); fem. gen. sg.
θανάτῳ: θάνατος — death; masc. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by a (pitiful) death’ · also dat. after ἐοικώς ’like’: ’like death’ (θανάτῳ ἄγχιστα ἐοικώς ’most like death’)
κάκιστος: κακός — bad; superlative κάκιστος, masc. nom. sg.: ’worst’
κεχάροντο: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; redupl. aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they rejoiced’
μερμηρίζων: μερμηρίζω — ponder anxiously, turn over in one’s mind; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
πλούτῳ: πλοῦτος — wealth; masc. dat. sg., dat. of respect or cause: ‘in (for) wealth’
σταθμῷ: σταθμός — steading, farm-building, stall; masc. dat. sg. · also door-post, jamb (σταθμῷ κυπαρισσίνῳ ’a cypress door-post’)
τένοντας: τένων — sinew, tendon; masc. acc. pl.
τινὰ: τις, τι — someone, something, anyone; indef. pron., masc./fem. acc. sg. · also adjectival, masc. acc. sg. with a noun: ’some’ (τινὰ … μόρον ’some doom’)
φράζετο: φράζομαι — consider, think, plan; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφράζετο): ’thought, devised’
φόνῳ: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. dat. sg.
χαλεπόν: χαλεπός — hard, difficult, harsh; neut. nom. sg., impersonal predicate: ’(it is) hard’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive: ’harsh’ (χαλεπὸν … μῦθον ’a harsh speech’)
ἀέθλῳ: ἄεθλος — contest, struggle; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄθλῳ)
ἄμβροτα: ἄμβροτος — immortal, divine, undying; adj., neut. acc. pl., epic (= ἀθάνατος)
ἐνένιπε: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, chide; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aor. (= ἐνένιπεν, aor. ἐνένιπον)
ἐξεναρίξας: ἐξεναρίζω — strip of armour, slay; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having slain’
ἔκτεινεν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., augmented (ν-movable)
ἔσσυο: σεύω — mid. rush, hasten; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic σσ: ’you rushed, hurried’
ὀφέλλειεν: ὀφέλλω — increase, augment (not to be confused with ὀφείλω ’owe’); opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would increase’
ὀφέλλειν: ὀφέλλω — increase, enlarge; pres. inf. act. (οἶκον ὀφέλλειν ’to enlarge a household’)
ὁμίλεον: ὁμιλέω — be in company, throng; fight in a crowd; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ὡμίλουν)
ὄλβῳ: ὄλβος — prosperity, wealth; masc. dat. sg., dat. of respect or cause: ‘in (for) prosperity’
